You are a subagent spawned by another session.
You are implementing one child ticket of Linear ALE-446 ("Convert the strongest frontend workflow candidates to XState") in the dhc-dashboard repo.

## Where to work
- Work ONLY in the GitButler linked worktree: /Users/alessandro.cuppari/.gitbutler-worktrees/dhc-dashboard/feature-ale-449-notification-recovery (branch `feature/ale-449-notification-recovery`, which is the umbrella branch for all of ALE-446). Never edit files in /Users/alessandro.cuppari/repos/dhc-dashboard (the main checkout) — other work lives there.
- Dependencies are installed (`pnpm install` done, `.env` copied). Run tools through `mise exec --` (e.g. `mise exec -- pnpm ...`) from that worktree.
- Version control: load the `gitbutler` skill and use `but` only (raw git writes are blocked). In this linked worktree, `but commit -m "<msg>" <paths...>` commits onto the worktree's branch; do NOT pass `-b`, do not create new branches, do not push, do not open a PR. Commit only files you changed, by path. Conventional-commit style messages naming the ticket, e.g. `refactor(web): ... (ALE-449)`.
- Nested subagents are unavailable to you; search directly with rg/glob/read.

## Your ticket: ALE-449 — Convert notification connection recovery to an XState machine
A previous session already committed a first implementation on this branch: commit `ryrt` "fix: model notification recovery and stabilize layout snapshots" (touches apps/web/src/lib/components/notifications/notification-realtime.svelte.ts, notification-realtime.test.ts, AGENTS.md, and a beginners-workshop section-layout browser test). Your job is to verify it against the ticket and finish whatever is missing.

1. Read the full ticket and parent via the Linear MCP inside `execute`: `tools.linear.get_issue({id:"ALE-449"})`, `tools.linear.get_issue({id:"ALE-446"})` (parent agent notes section "1. Notifications" has the detailed constraints), and `tools.linear.list_comments({issueId:"ALE-449"})`.
2. Read the repo guidance: AGENTS.md (worktree copy), docs/agents/critical-patterns.md and docs/agents/notes.md sections relevant to XState / runes / tests. Prior art: apps/web/src/lib/invitation-acceptance/ (paymentMachine) and workshop-checkout-machine.ts.
3. Inspect `but diff ryrt` and the current files. Check each acceptance criterion / testing decision in ALE-449 (e.g. the machine owns fresh-token acquisition, socket/channel lifetime, backoff schedule+ceiling preserved exactly vs main's previous implementation (compare with `git show main:<path>` — read-only git is allowed? if blocked, use `but show`/the main checkout file read-only), token-fetch timeout, 401 terminal, stale token / late socket discarded+destroyed, retired-socket revival disconnected, no competing reconnect loop, invalidation on join/rejoin/creation signal, idempotent destroy, no module-level actor, NotificationCenter.svelte unchanged, public `connectNotificationRealtime(config) → { destroy }` preserved). Make sure pure machine tests with fake timers cover the listed cases: first connect; token failure, empty result, hang; unauthorized termination; socket error and close; backoff progression and reset; stale token and late socket; retired-socket revival; repeated events; idempotent destroy. Add/fix what is missing. Remove any leftover procedural protocol flags that duplicate the machine.
4. Also judge whether the unrelated-looking change to apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/beginners-workshop/section-layout.browser.test.ts in that commit is justified (it "stabilizes layout snapshots"); keep it if it fixes a flake needed to get the suite green, and tell me what it does.
5. Use the official Svelte MCP (`tools.svelte.*` inside `execute`; search for its tools first) if you touch any .svelte/.svelte.ts module.

## Green before done
From apps/web in the worktree: `mise exec -- pnpm check` (run first — it does svelte-kit sync), `mise exec -- pnpm lint`, focused `mise exec -- pnpm test:unit --run <relevant test files>` (unit + browser projects; note runes controllers are tested as *.svelte.browser.test.ts), and `mise exec -- pnpm build`. Known startup flakes (Miniflare SQLITE_BUSY, Vite "optimized dependencies changed") pass on rerun. Fix real failures you caused; report pre-existing ones without fixing. Do not run Phoenix codegen or change API contracts.

## Report back
- What you changed (files) and the commit ID(s) you made (or "no changes needed" with evidence).
- Per acceptance criterion: met / how verified.
- Exact verification commands and results.
- Any AGENTS.md note a future agent needs (pass it to me as text; the existing ALE-449 AGENTS.md paragraph from the commit may be adjusted by you if it is inaccurate).
- Anything you noticed but left alone.
